game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Wind Pass, a howling mountain pass: the mountaineer must hold off falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Wind Pass: a howling mountain pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Wind Pass, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Then check vowels and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from falling rocks in Wind Pass: keep vowels above zero until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 6, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
